articles.title: Risk-off wave drags bitcoin below $63,000 as AI selloff spreads from stocks to crypto
articles.snippet: Crypto fell as AI stock fatigue and U.S.-Iran tensions weighed on sentiment, though a technical measure hints at oversold conditions heading into the weekend.

articles.title: DOG Mode vs. BIP-110: Inside the Bitcoin client built to bypass data restrictions
articles.snippet: While BIP 110 wants to restrict data through a consensus change and has almost no miner support, a new DOG Mode client wants the opposite and requires no vote at all.
